t: Manufacture and distribution of stamps and stamped paper, $1,769,400.

fable.w: This is a bare appropriation line item funding the manufacture and distribution of stamps and stamped paper. It involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue involving any party outside the federal government. There is no tempting participation reading here; nothing in the text refers to outside parties taking part in a federal decision.
fable.s: Manufacture and distribution of stamps and stamped paper, $1,769,400.
